title: DOC: Added dissociation tutorial
body:
Closes #1787 

The animation required allowing ```matplotlib_animations``` in the sphinx config (see https://sphinx-gallery.github.io/stable/configuration.html#image-scrapers).
This in turn also required a pip install of ```sphinxcontrib-video```.

comments.author: Zausinator
comments.body:
Hey! So I played around with a few things, and I was able to add an animation via the ```matplotlib.animations``` package. However, to get this running in the browser required setting ```"sphinx_gallery_conf={"matplotlib_animations": (True, 'mp4')}```, which in turn required me to install ```sphinxcontrib-video```.

Is this acceptable?

comments.author: HannaTuerk
comments.body: From my side I think it is acceptable as it adds quite a nice new feature, @ajjackson and @askhl any thoughts/objections?

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests adding a gallery image to the tutorial, implying a concrete addition to the PR.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body:
snake_case: s/N2_distance/n2_distance/

```suggestion:-39+0
n2_distances = []
energy_differences = []
for i, config in enumerate(configs):
    n2_distance = np.linalg.norm(config[-2].position - config[-1].position)
    delta_energy = config.get_potential_energy() - energy_initial
    n2_distances.append(n2_distance)
    energy_differences.append(delta_energy)
    print(
        f'{i:>3}\td = {n2_distance:>4.3f}AA '
        f'\tdelta energy = {delta_energy:>5.3f}eV'
    )

# %%
# After the calculation is complete, the energy difference
# with respect to the initial state is given for each image,
# as well as the distance between the N atoms.
#

energy_differences = [e * 1.0e03 for e in energy_differences]  # in meV

fig, axs = plt.subplots(
    2,
    1,
    gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [0.5, 1.0]},
)

axs[0].plot(n2_distances, energy_differences)
scat = axs[0].scatter(n2_distances[0], energy_differences[0], s=10.0**2.0)
axs[0].set_ylabel(r'$E(i) - E_{\mathrm{initial}}$ (meV)')
axs[0].set_xlabel(r'$d_{\mathrm{N}-\mathrm{N}} (\AA)$')

# Plot the atomic structure, focussing on the two Nitrogen atoms
plot_atoms(config, axs[1], rotation='0x', show_unit_cell=0)
axs[1].set_axis_off()
axs[1].set_ylim(0.0, 5.642)
axs[1].set_xlim(0.0, 14.833)


def animate(i):
    scat.set_offsets((n2_distances[i], energy_differences[i]))
```
comments.label_reasoning: Reviewer explicitly flags snake_case violation (N2_distance → n2_distance) and provides a full corrected suggestion.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests snake_case renaming and provides a detailed code suggestion block.
